gaps.detail: Most of the 25 critical Home Base domains have native surfaces but their old phone/Termux data, saves, project history, production records, and package state are not yet reconciled on-device.
gaps.finish_gate: Run Phone Intake + Continuity import, compare counts/hashes, reconcile missing items, and preserve rollback.

gaps.detail: 144 of 144 canonical route slots are still placeholders; the current UI exposes 39 distinct literal routes.
gaps.finish_gate: Recover/bind the canonical R10 route registry and test all 144 routes for render, persistence and back navigation.

gaps.detail: V24 can inventory/copy only Android document trees the user explicitly authorizes. Other apps' private sandboxes and protected system storage cannot be silently scanned.
gaps.finish_gate: Authorize the broadest Internal Storage tree, index it, repeat for SD/Drive/providers, and import app-owned data through their own exports when needed.

gaps.detail: Library metadata search exists, but an all-app content index still needs unified full-text search across projects, source code, notes, Bible context, books, continuity, patents and phone-intake metadata.
gaps.finish_gate: Add an incremental FTS index, extract supported document text, preserve source/page anchors, and expose one global search surface.

gaps.detail: The Scripture reader has page mode, but the app still needs polished in-app viewers/editors for PDFs/EPUBs/text/source/images/audio/video/archives and strong page/bookmark/history behavior.
gaps.finish_gate: Add format-aware viewers, bookmarks, recent position, TOC, annotations, safe editing/versioning and external-open fallback.

gaps.detail: My Work and Constructor can navigate/index projects, but HeritageFaith deliberately does not execute arbitrary shell code. Historical Termux automation is not yet a safe in-app execution engine.
gaps.finish_gate: Add an explicit sandboxed task runner with allowlisted tools, dry-run/approval, logs, timeouts, rollback and file-diff review.

gaps.detail: The 144-field runtime exists, but old Kernel Computer state/packages are not considered migrated until actual files are found and verified.
gaps.finish_gate: Recover Kernel packages/state through Phone Intake/Continuity and attach hashes/version lineage.

gaps.detail: Game/Garden records and launch surfaces exist, but emulator/runtime compatibility, real Garden branch execution and save persistence still need device testing and import.
gaps.finish_gate: Bind game engines/emulator handoffs, import saves, test reopen/save/load, and verify Garden current branch.

gaps.detail: Drive folders are registered and recursive import exists, but all six libraries still need real on-device import/reconciliation and full catalog counts.
gaps.finish_gate: Import each authorized top-level folder, hash/dedupe, index titles/authors/text where supported, and reconcile failures/skips.

gaps.detail: The 70+ year patent inventory database/importer exists, but the historical corpus has not yet been populated.
gaps.finish_gate: Load authoritative bulk metadata, record source coverage, dedupe jurisdictions/families and index full-text links where available.

gaps.detail: These exist mainly as records, handoffs or device adapters rather than complete standalone clients.
gaps.finish_gate: Test/import each domain on-device, add attachment handling and preserve explicit permission boundaries.

gaps.detail: Backup/rollback code exists, but an all-encompassing private app needs proven restore, encrypted export, optional biometric lock and disaster-recovery tests.
gaps.finish_gate: Backup test data, restore it, verify hashes/counts, test rollback, add encrypted backup option and recovery-key workflow.

gaps.detail: Phone Intake has safety limits; a very large personal archive needs resumable scans, incremental change detection, dedupe/content-addressing, storage budgets and background-safe jobs.
gaps.finish_gate: Add resumable checkpoints, modified-file detection, content-addressed blobs, duplicate references and storage quota controls.

gaps.detail: GitHub can build the APK, but long-term private upgrades should use a persistent signing key, versioned release artifacts and verified update/rollback packages.
gaps.finish_gate: Create stable private signing, signed release APK, checksum manifest and upgrade/rollback acceptance test.

gaps.detail: The Assistant Bridge can export/import scoped context, but it intentionally does not give ChatGPT silent background access to the installed app or phone.
gaps.finish_gate: Keep explicit user-approved handoff; optionally automate export to an authorized connected folder without granting hidden phone control.

definition_of_done: All 25 critical Home Base domains have a verified runtime state and historical-data state.
All 144 canonical routes are bound and physically tested.
Phone/Drive/Continuity imports are reconciled with counts and hashes.
Kernel, games, Garden and saves are actually run/reopened on the phone.
Global full-text search covers supported local content with source/page anchors.
Backup/restore/rollback pass on disposable test data.
A stable signed private upgrade build installs over the predecessor without data loss.
Anything Android cannot access remains visibly labeled rather than guessed or omitted.
